title: Chat Stacks
description: This mod makes repeated chats clean. What I mean by this is that if your friend is spamming something it makes it go x2, x3, x4, x5 and so on
body: Keep your Minecraft chat clean by automatically stacking repeated messages instead of showing endless duplicates. Identical messages are combined into one with a counter like x2, x3, x4, x5, and beyond, reducing chat spam and making conversations much easier to follow.
